fact: Sonatel (Orange Group) states the 2Africa submarine cable was commissioned in December 2025 at the Senegal landing station, which Sonatel owns and operates.
Agence Ecofin states that Senegal hosts several submarine cable systems, including 2Africa, ACE and SAT-3 (three named).
Connecting Africa (27 Jan 2025) states several submarine cables are already connected to Dakar, including ACE, MainOne, Sat-3, SHARE and 2Africa (five named); no landing stations given.
DCD (23 Jan 2025) reports PAIX's CEO citing Dakar's aggregation of submarine-cable landings, ACE, MainOne, SAT-3 and SHARE (four named), with 2Africa to join; no landing stations given.
source_slug: 2025-01-23 PAIX Data Centres breaks ground on Dakar data center

fact: Onix's press release (11 May 2023) says its carrier-neutral data centre at the Almadies 2Africa cable landing station in Dakar gives local and international companies direct access to multiple subsea cables and backhaul routes on carrier-neutral terms.

DCD (20 Feb 2023) quotes Onix saying customers at its Dakar facility can connect to all submarine cables in Senegal: ACE, MainOne and 2Africa (three named); landing stations not given apart from the 2Africa station.
Onix, quoted by DCD, says its neutral colocation facility at the 2Africa landing station in Dakar lets customers connect to all submarine cables in Senegal in a wholesale environment.
